info.bio: Gary Glitter nació el 8 de mayo de 1940 en Banbury. Estrella del glam de los ‘70. Inició su carrera en un grupo de skiffle, Paul Russell & The Rebels, después se llamó Paul Raven y posteriormente Gary Glitter. Aparecía con vestimentas plateadas y maquillaje que hicieron furor a principios de los años 70. podcast.body: Gary Glitter is a disgraced and convicted pedophile, a status that has led to a widespread desire to prevent him from earning any record royalties from his music. "Gary Glitter is a disgraced and convicted pitophile. No one wants to see him make any record royalties ever again."

xref.body: The Timelords released a Doctor Who themed hit that notably utilized the Gary Glitter song "Rock and Roll Part 2." "They resurfaced under the name of the Timelords, who released a Doctor Who themed hit that made the use of the Gary Glitter song Rock and Roll Part 2."

xref.title: Transformation into The Timelords and KLF
xref.body: After The Jams, they resurfaced as The Timelords, releasing a Doctor Who-themed hit that sampled Gary Glitter's "Rock and Roll Part 2," and subsequently morphed into The KLF. "They resurfaced under the name of the Timelords, who released a Doctor Who themed hit that made the use of the Gary Glitter song Rock and Roll Part 2, and from there they morphed into the KLF."
